detail.longDescription: Okay thank to a screenshot by @ memoriesin8bit I got motivated again to work on "Tiny Gardener" for a bit. So a new update is live: https:// github.com/XanatosX/tiny-garde ner/releases#release-p0.0.8 There is a end of the game now! Also the UI changed a little bit and there are more upgrades to buy. Also the handbook entries unlock as you progress. Still a prototype Test it on the web, for free: https:// xanatos.itch.io/tiny-gardener # Godot # Godot4 # OpenSource # TinyGardener # GameDev # GameDeveloper # GamePrototype
